customer: Good afternoon, I'm hoping to sell my minivan to Northwind Auto, but my former wife's name is still on the title from before our divorce. Would she need to sign as well, or is there another way to handle this? I'd be grateful for any guidance.
agent: Thank you for reaching out, and I'm happy to help. If your ex-spouse is still listed on the title, she would need to sign too, the same as any co-owner. The exception is if your divorce decree awards the minivan to you: in that case, bring a certified copy of the decree and her signature isn't needed. Also, if either of your names changed in the divorce, our article "The name on the title doesn't match my ID" covers that situation.
